description: Submitted answers checked against their form: Required on the pages a respondent goes through (visibility rules and page jumps), answer rules and answer types. Run by backend/tests/app/services/test_answer_validation.py (every case) and webapp src/utils/answer-validation-cases.test.ts (the cases whose checks include 'required', 'rules' or 'fieldRules'). Checks 'server' are the server's alone: answer types and unknown ids (the respondent page builds its answers itself), and the cases in 'clientDiffers', which says why the browser differs on purpose. 'form' is the list of pages as the respondent page receives it; 'errors' lists every problem, in any order. Checks 'fieldRules' are field rules (properties.rules): the server replays them before validating (the values they set or lock, then Required with the rules applied); 'answersAfter' lists answers as the server stores them after the replay (null: none stored). The respondent page evaluates them with its own twin (webapp src/lib/field-rules.ts), which the webapp runner runs for these cases too; what the rules decide beyond validation is in field-rules.cases.json.
